title: CAPER: PartGround and PlanRefine for Reliable Manual-Guided Robotic Assembly Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.32986v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Models (VLMs) used in robot task planning to derive assembly procedures from existing manuals may correctly interpret individual assembly actions yet confuse exact part identities, predict unsupported Part IDs, or produce inconsistent parts across assembly steps. Thus, we propose CAPER (Capacity-Aware Part-grounding and Evidence Refinement), a manual-guided robotic assembly framework that enables VLMs to generate assembly procedures with two modules--PartGround and PlanRefine. PartGround aligns step-level manual evidence with product-specific inventory and part-reference information to identify exact Part IDs and quantities, transforming free-form hardware prediction into evidence-guided assignments represented in a shared Assembly Intermediate Representation (Assembly IR). translated_title: CAPER：面向可靠手册引导机器人装配规划的PartGround与PlanRefine
translated_abstract: 在机器人任务规划中，使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）从现有手册中推导装配步骤时，虽然可能正确解读单个装配动作，但常常会混淆确切的零件身份、预测出不支持的零件ID，或在装配步骤之间产生不一致的零件。为此，我们提出了CAPER（Capacity-Aware Part-grounding and Evidence Refinement，容量感知零件定位与证据精炼），这是一个手册引导的机器人装配框架，通过两个模块——PartGround和PlanRefine——使VLM能够生成装配步骤。PartGround将步骤级的手册证据与产品特定的库存及零件参考信息对齐，以识别确切的零件ID和数量，将自由形式的硬件预测转化为以共享装配中间表示（Assembly IR）呈现的证据引导的分配。PlanRefine则对照有限库存对PartGround的分配进行审计，移除置信度最低的分配。对于身份不确定的情况则保持标记……
tldr: 提出CAPER框架，通过PartGround将手册证据与产品库存对齐以准确定位零件、并通过PlanRefine对照有限库存精炼计划，使视觉-语言模型能够可靠地生成机器人装配规划。
en_tdlr: CAPER enables VLMs to reliably generate robotic assembly plans from manuals by grounding exact part identities against product-specific inventory (PartGround) and refining the plan against finite inventory (PlanRefine).
